title: Dynamic RBAC role templates with residency-aware KMS fallback
author: Lina Chen
release_notes: Adds dynamic RBAC role templates with residency constraints, a KMS routing fallback for tenant-scoped keys, and audit envelope tagging to preserve region provenance. Includes migration helper and console UI flags.
description:
Context and motivation: Customers with mixed residency requirements asked for a way to express operator roles that are automatically scoped by tenant residency without proliferating one-off role records. Separately, we needed a robust fallback for cross-region KMS availability to prevent unrecoverable failures while preserving a strong audit trail. This PR introduces dynamic RBAC role templates (+compiler), a residency-aware KMS fallback proxy, and persistent audit envelope tags that record the selected key decision.

What this changes (high level): 1) Role template engine: new template DSL (yaml) + compiler that expands templates into RBAC v2 decisions at auth-time based on the tenant residency claim. Templates support conditions like region==eu or classification==sensitive. 2) Residency-aware KMS fallback proxy: runtime middleware that attempts tenant-preferred CMK, then falls back to a constrained cross-region key only when policy allows; all fallbacks are recorded into a sealed audit envelope. 3) Audit envelope tagging: audit records now include provenance fields (preferred_region, used_key_id, fallback_reason) and are signed with the active key to preserve integrity. 4) Migration: a safe database migration + idempotent migration helper to convert a small percentage of existing role bindings into template-backed entries to avoid mass manual changes. 5) Console/CLI: feature flags to preview template evaluation per-tenant and a migration status page.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-4923) - [x] Template DSL + compiler tests - [x] End-to-end integration tests for KMS fallback path - [x] Audit envelope format change + backward compatibility shim - [x] Migration helper and dry-run mode - [x] Console preview UI and feature flag gating - [x] Security review and threat model updated

Commits (summary): - Add role template DSL and basic compiler (lina/role-templates) - Wire template evaluation into rbac-decision service (lina/rbac-eval) - Introduce kms-fallback-proxy middleware and new routing policy (lina/kms-fallback) - Add audit envelope taggers and sign/verify helpers (lina/audit-tags) - Migration helper and dry-run CLI (lina/migrate-templates) - Console preview page and feature flag toggles (lina/console-templates) - Tests, docs, and changelog entries

Files changed (high level): - rbac/templating/compiler.go (new): core DSL compiler and evaluation engine - rbac/templating/specs/*.yaml (new): example templates - rbac/service/eval.go: integrate template evaluation into decision path - kms/proxy/fallback.go (new): residency-aware routing, key selection, logging - audit/envelope/format.go: add provenance fields and signing metadata - migrations/20260214_template_roles.go: DB migration - cli/migrate_templates.go: dry-run migration helper - web/console/src/pages/templates/Preview.tsx: console preview UI - docs/security/role-templates.md: design and operations guide - tests/*: unit and integration tests

Review conversation (high level): - Marcus: requested stricter validation around template condition expressions; added a sandboxed evaluator and test vectors. - Deepa: asked for additional telemetry to track fallback rates per-tenant and per-region; added a metrics counter and dashboard stub. - Rafael: flagged potential latency impact during auth path; we introduced a small in-memory clamp cache for recent template evaluations and added benchmark numbers to the PR. - Security team (Amanpreet): requested signed audit envelopes for any fallback action; implemented envelope signing and verify path. - Author replies: clarified that fallback is only allowed if tenant policy permits cross-region usage and that the migration helper runs in dry-run by default.

CI summary: - unit-tests: pass - integration-tests (inc. KMS emulator): pass - lint: pass - e2e smoke: pass - policy-scan: pass - ephemeral flaky: one flaky test (rbac/templating) retried and passed; final CI status: pass

Backward compatibility and risk: - Audit envelope changes include a backward compatibility shim to allow older consumers to read events; migration for consumers is documented. - The template compiler introduces an opt-in feature flag at runtime; operators can enable templates for a single namespace/tenant before global rollout. - Because the KMS fallback can cross-region, the PR introduces telemetry and a safety rate limiter. Default behavior keeps strict residency and disallows fallback unless explicitly configured.

Operational notes: - Admins can preview template evaluation for any tenant in the console before enabling. - Migration helper supports dry-run and stepwise promotion. - Alerts added: fallback_rate_per_tenant > 0.5% for 1h and template_evaluation_errors > 1/min.

Merge outcome: merged to main via squash-and-merge after approvals from Marcus, Deepa, and Rafael. Deployed to staging behind feature flag on 2026-02-21; canary rollout to production scheduled for 2026-03-01 behind a controlled knob.

Related work: references ENG-4923 design doc, SEC-188 threat model, and a customer support ticket SUP-7124 that precipitated the feature.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated. To enable per-tenant role templates set SYSTEM_FEATURE_ROLE_TEMPLATES=true and run migration helper in dry-run then actual mode. If KMS fallback is enabled, ensure fallback keys are added to kms.allowlist and monitor fallback_rate dashboards.
changelog_entry: Introduce dynamic RBAC role templates with residency conditions and KMS fallback with audit provenance. Opt-in feature behind console flags and migration helper.
testing_notes: Integration tests use KMS emulator and cover primary + fallback key flows. Benchmarks show median auth-decision p95 increased by 4ms with cache enabled; documented in PR.
security_review: Completed: signed audit envelopes, template evaluator sandboxed, allowlist enforced for KMS fallbacks.
migration_instructions: Run cli/migrate_templates --dry-run --since=2026-02-01 to assess impact. If results look good, run without --dry-run. Migration is idempotent. Monitor metrics and swap feature flag when ready.
